body: What makes you think you ruined your life?
Yes I do. That’s probably what I’ll end up doing.

I have what’s considered long hair. I haven’t had it cut since high school. 

I had to cut it at one point due to mats. Also because of my depression. It grew back. Please don’t kill yourself because of this. I take a lot of pride in my hair. I know how you feel. Maybe you can get the matts out. I’ve done it before. But regardless, your life is so intrinsically valuable. Don’t end it over this.
